topic: strict-utf8 stdin readers must tolerate replaced stdin without .buffer
lesson: read_stdin_utf8 (factory_lib ~line 1005) crashes AttributeError when sys.stdin was replaced by a bufferless text stream (StringIO — pytest and embedders do this; pre_tool_use imports it at module load, so the whole hook chain dies): use buffer = getattr(sys.stdin, 'buffer', None) and fall back to sys.stdin.read() when absent — the replaced stream is already text and carries no bytes to re-decode. test_hook_module_chain_has_no_posix_only_imports is the regression net (currently the only red test: 1 failed, 565 passed).
